text: I read the reviews and it reminded me of my aunt's case. She went for a dental check-up and general consultation, without deciding on any treatment. Suddenly, they had her lie down for a procedure without explaining what was going to happen. There was no explanation whatsoever, not even from the dentist or nurse. After almost two hours, her teeth looked amazing. The total bill was around 70,000 baht. She thought, "Well, since it's already been done, let it go. It looks good enough." Soon after, she started encountering problems. The clinic scheduled follow-up check-ups, costing her more money. Almost two months later, the veneers (similar to what's done now) had all fallen off, leaving her teeth in their original damaged state. My aunt said she didn't know about social media or reviews back then; she'd already made the mistake and couldn't do anything about it. She decided to just let it go, but she will never go back there again. I'm writing this review as a warning. Be mindful, ask detailed questions, protect yourself, and check every step before undergoing any treatment at this clinic.
